## Final prompt set

### packaging-system-hero.png
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: custom packaging website hero. Primary request: a bold collection of unbranded custom packaging prototypes including a corrugated shipper, printed folding carton, premium rigid box, protective paper insert and flat dieline sample. Scene/backdrop: bright creative packaging studio tabletop with cream paper, cobalt blue, tomato red and warm yellow color fields. Subject: cohesive packaging system shown both assembled and partially unfolded, clearly demonstrating structure and print. Style/medium: highly photorealistic premium packaging campaign photography. Composition/framing: wide landscape overhead-to-three-quarter view, playful modular arrangement with boxes at different heights and a clear flat dieline area. Lighting/mood: crisp softbox studio light, optimistic, tactile and design-forward. Color palette: warm cream, cobalt blue, tomato red, bright yellow, kraft brown and black ink. Materials/textures: corrugated kraft board, smooth folding carton, textured rigid-board wrap, molded paper insert. Constraints: no readable text, no logos, no brands, no watermark; physically plausible folds and box construction. Avoid: luxury cosmetics clichés, plastic packaging, excessive ribbons, impossible geometry, sterile gray industrial scene.

### corrugated-mailers.png
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: custom corrugated mailer family image. Primary request: a premium unbranded corrugated mailer box shown closed, open with protective paper insert, and flat as a clean dieline prototype. Scene/backdrop: cobalt blue studio surface with cream and tomato-red paper swatches. Subject: kraft and white corrugated mailer structures with realistic tabs, scores and locking flaps. Style/medium: photorealistic packaging design studio photography. Composition/framing: landscape three-quarter arrangement showing all three structural states. Lighting/mood: bright controlled studio lighting with crisp paper shadows. Color palette: kraft brown, white, cobalt blue, tomato red and small warm-yellow accents. Materials/textures: E-flute corrugated board, uncoated kraft paper, molded paper insert. Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, construction must be foldable and physically plausible. Avoid: tape covering structure, plastic filler, glossy luxury box, impossible dieline.

### folding-cartons.png
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: printed folding carton family image. Primary request: a family of unbranded printed folding cartons in several practical sizes, plus one opened carton and one flat printed sheet with score lines. Scene/backdrop: warm cream studio surface with bold cobalt, tomato-red and yellow graphic color blocks. Subject: precise paperboard cartons demonstrating print registration, tuck flaps and compact retail structure. Style/medium: highly photorealistic editorial packaging photography. Composition/framing: wide landscape front three-quarter view with boxes rhythmically arranged like a graphic design composition. Lighting/mood: bright daylight studio light, energetic and contemporary. Color palette: cobalt blue, tomato red, warm yellow, cream and black. Materials/textures: smooth SBS paperboard, matte aqueous finish, clean scored folds. Constraints: abstract color blocks only, no readable text, no logos, no watermark, plausible carton construction. Avoid: cosmetic branding, foil luxury effects, plastic windows, clutter.

### rigid-boxes.png
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: premium rigid packaging family image. Primary request: a premium unbranded rigid box system with lift-off lid, paper-wrapped tray, fitted paper insert and two coordinated sizes. Scene/backdrop: tomato-red studio surface with cream, cobalt and warm-yellow graphic panels. Subject: thick paperboard boxes shown open and closed with visible wrapped edges and fitted insert. Style/medium: photorealistic high-end packaging prototype photography with playful modern art direction. Composition/framing: landscape close three-quarter view emphasizing structure, fit and tactile paper. Lighting/mood: soft but vivid studio lighting with controlled shadows. Color palette: tomato red, cream, cobalt blue, warm yellow and black. Materials/textures: textured paper wrap, dense grayboard, molded paper insert. Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no product inside, physically plausible construction. Avoid: jewelry, perfume, ribbons, magnetic gimmicks, metallic foil, velvet.

### packaging-prototyping.png
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: packaging prototyping and production image. Primary request: packaging engineer reviewing a freshly cut corrugated prototype at a digital cutting table with printed dieline sheets nearby. Scene/backdrop: clean real-world packaging sample room with cutting plotter, paperboard racks and organized workbench. Subject: one engineer in practical workwear checking fold alignment and insert fit; identity not emphasized. Style/medium: photorealistic candid industrial editorial photography. Composition/framing: landscape medium-wide view showing person, prototype, cutting table and paperboard context. Lighting/mood: bright neutral workshop light, collaborative and precise. Color palette: cream, kraft, cobalt, tomato red and warm yellow accents. Materials/textures: corrugated board, printed paperboard, steel cutting table, real workwear. Constraints: safe activity, no readable text, no logos, no watermark. Avoid: sparks, heavy factory smoke, staged handshake, oversized printing press, glossy stock photo.

### social-preview.png
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: social preview card for a fictional custom packaging manufacturer. Primary request: bold landscape social card showing a playful modular arrangement of corrugated mailer, folding carton, rigid box and flat dieline prototype. Scene/backdrop: cream graphic field with cobalt blue, tomato red and warm yellow blocks and subtle paper texture. Subject: photorealistic unbranded packages integrated with oversized editorial typography. Style/medium: contemporary packaging-design campaign, tactile, graphic and highly legible. Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, typography safely inside left margin and modular packaging composition on the right. Lighting/mood: bright optimistic studio lighting. Color palette: warm cream, cobalt blue, tomato red, bright yellow, kraft and black. Text (verbatim): “TUCKFORM PACKAGING” and “From flat idea to repeatable pack.” Constraints: render both lines exactly once; no other text; no logos or trademarks; no watermark; plausible box construction. Avoid: muted corporate blue, dark industrial aesthetic, luxury cosmetic clichés, tiny labels, clutter.

## Demo boundary

These assets visualize fictional structures and production contexts only. They are not evidence of real designs, customers, facilities, materials, print performance, sustainability credentials, MOQ or manufacturing capability.
